title: Riverfront Condo: Pool, Walk to Broadwauy
description:
Experience Nashville from this modern, country-western themed riverfront apartment in vibrant Germantown. Enjoy stunning river views, a comfortable King bed, and a pull-out sofa. Walk to Germantown restaurants, Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, and Ascend Amphitheater. Features a shared pool and easy self check-in. Comfortably fits 4 guests, perfect for city explorers.

The space
Welcome to your unique Nashville retreat!
   Theme: Modern apartment with a subtle country-western theme.
   Living Area: Bright, spacious main living area with comfortable furnishings and an open layout, seamlessly flowing into the kitchen.
   Bathroom: Clean, contemporary bathroom.
   *Sleeping Arrangements:
       One comfortable King bed.
       One convenient pull-out sofa for additional guests.
   Capacity: Comfortably fits 4 people.
Unique Feature: Enjoy a unique riverfront experience with views of boats passing by.

Guest access
Guest have use of entire condo.
